scope: UI46/BI01 chart readability at narrow width; no additional visual sweep

evidence.observation: Twelve month labels and values were visibly tiny while source buttons were legible. The SVG has a 700-unit-wide viewBox and 12 px labels but was reduced to approximately 226 px content width.
evidence.geometricInference: 12 × 226/700 is approximately 3.87 CSS pixels. This explains the screenshot; it is not a measured browser CTM receipt.

changes: A per-series caption id names a keyboard-focusable chart scroll region: role=region, tabIndex=0 and aria-labelledby.
Only the SVG is inside the horizontal scroller. Original source buttons remain outside it.
The chart width token is 700 px, equal to the unchanged SVG viewBox width. The original 12 px text rule remains.

Minimum SVG block size equals the unchanged original viewBox height. The 38rem maximum remains declared; when a longer series needs more height, the minimum wins and the chart grows vertically, including on desktop, to preserve its readable scale.
Focus uses the existing --sf-focus-width and --mx-blue tokens; no new material, palette or blur is added.
implementation.sharedRendererScope: SfBiOwnedFigure is the existing renderer shared by BI01–BI08. The wrapper and minimum readable geometry apply to its existing SVG series; there is no new renderer, data path or view-specific calculation.

All numeric formatting, source admission, model construction, financial values and amounts.
The original extent/magnitude math and SVG bar/label/title content.

coldReview.evidence: Independent comparison confirmed identical SVG marks ignoring indentation, unchanged formatter, byte-identical source-actions remainder, coherent createUniqueId/caption/region association and containment by min-inline-size:0 ancestors.

Long series can become taller on desktop to preserve readable scale; this is not an unchanged hard height cap. Runtime font size and wheel behavior remain pending Matrix6.
